title: Result.match requires both the success and the error branch
notes: specification/failures.mdx, 'Matching and Transformation': 'match MUST require both success and error branches.' An object literal carrying only ok must be refused by ordinary TypeScript checking (specification/compatibility.mdx). 2026-09-07 native-only migration: the SDK now checks authored source with the same Go Result signatures as standalone emission. Both report TS2345 at 11:31, with the complete diagnostic chain naming the missing error branch. The removed frontend's generated-SDK TS2741 convention is not a language rule. This negative case requires an actual native source-check observation; accepted output cases still require emitted-code checking. No TS diagnostic aliases were introduced.
